tasks.label: Core: build
tasks.detail: Builds the macOS-independent logic package. Runs in the dev container.

tasks.label: Core: test
tasks.detail: Runs the unit tests for state detection, reset-time parsing and the resume scheduler.

tasks.label: Core: test (watch)
tasks.command: while inotifywait -r -e modify,create,delete Packages/SentinelCore/Sources Packages/SentinelCore/Tests; do swift test --package-path Packages/SentinelCore; done
tasks.detail: Re-runs the core tests on every change. Requires inotify-tools.

tasks.label: Site: serve
tasks.detail: Serves docs/site on port 8080 for local preview of the GitHub Pages site.

tasks.label: Site: check bilingual parity
tasks.command: diff <(cd docs/site/en && find . -name '*.html' | sort) <(cd docs/site/ja && find . -name '*.html' | sort) && echo 'EN and JA page sets match.'
tasks.detail: Fails if the English and Japanese page sets have drifted apart.

tasks.label: App: build (host macOS only)
tasks.command: echo 'App/ cannot be built inside the dev container. Run this on the host Mac: xcodebuild -scheme XcodeSentinel -configuration Debug build'
tasks.detail: Reminder task. The macOS app requires Xcode on the host.
